import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, StratifiedKFold, cross_val_predict
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import classification_report, roc_auc_score, confusion_matrix
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier, GradientBoostingClassifier, StackingClassifier
from imblearn.over_sampling import SMOTE
import featuretools as ft
import xgboost as xgb
import lightgbm as lgb
from typing import Tuple, Dict, Any


def load_data() -> pd.DataFrame:
    url: str = "https://archive.ics.uci.edu/ml/machine-learning-databases/00350/default%20of%20credit%20card%20clients.xls"
    df: pd.DataFrame = pd.read_excel(url, header=1, index_col=0)
    df.columns = df.columns.str.strip().str.upper().str.replace(" ", "_")
    return df


def preprocess_data(df: pd.DataFrame) -> Tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.Series]:
    df = df.dropna()
    X: pd.DataFrame = df.drop("DEFAULT_PAYMENT_NEXT_MONTH", axis=1)
    y: pd.Series = df["DEFAULT_PAYMENT_NEXT_MONTH"]
    return X, y


def feature_engineering(X: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    es: ft.EntitySet = ft.EntitySet(id='credit')
    es = es.add_dataframe(dataframe_name='clients', dataframe=X, index='INDEX')
    feature_matrix, _ = ft.dfs(entityset=es, target_dataframe_name='clients', verbose=0)
    return feature_matrix.dropna(axis=1)


def balance_classes(X: pd.DataFrame, y: pd.Series) -> Tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.Series]:
    smote = SMOTE(random_state=42)
    X_resampled, y_resampled = smote.fit_resample(X, y)
    return X_resampled, y_resampled


def scale_data(X: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    X_scaled: np.ndarray = scaler.fit_transform(X)
    return pd.DataFrame(X_scaled, columns=X.columns)


def train_models(X: pd.DataFrame, y: pd.Series) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    rf = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, random_state=42)
    xgb_clf = xgb.XGBClassifier(use_label_encoder=False, eval_metric='logloss')
    lgb_clf = lgb.LGBMClassifier()
    models = {'RandomForest': rf, 'XGBoost': xgb_clf, 'LightGBM': lgb_clf}

    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
    results = {}

    for name, model in models.items():
        y_pred = cross_val_predict(model, X, y, cv=skf, method='predict')
        results[name] = {
            'report': classification_report(y, y_pred, output_dict=True),
            'roc_auc': roc_auc_score(y, y_pred),
            'conf_matrix': confusion_matrix(y, y_pred)
        }
        model.fit(X, y)
        results[name]['model'] = model
    return results


def build_stacking_model(models: Dict[str, Any], X: pd.DataFrame, y: pd.Series) -> Any:
    base_learners = [(name, model['model']) for name, model in models.items()]
    final_estimator = GradientBoostingClassifier()
    stack = StackingClassifier(estimators=base_learners, final_estimator=final_estimator, cv=5)
    stack.fit(X, y)
    return stack


def predict(stack_model: Any, input_data: pd.DataFrame) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    input_scaled = StandardScaler().fit_transform(input_data)
    prob: float = stack_model.predict_proba(input_scaled)[:, 1][0]
    category: str = "High" if prob >= 0.7 else "Medium" if prob >= 0.4 else "Low"
    return {"Default_Probability": prob, "Risk_Category": category}


def main() -> None:
    df: pd.DataFrame = load_data()
    df['INDEX'] = df.index
    X, y = preprocess_data(df)
    X_fe = feature_engineering(X)
    X_bal, y_bal = balance_classes(X_fe, y)
    X_scaled = scale_data(X_bal)
    models = train_models(X_scaled, y_bal)
    stack_model = build_stacking_model(models, X_scaled, y_bal)

    sample: pd.DataFrame = X_scaled.iloc[[0]]
    result: Dict[str, Any] = predict(stack_model, sample)
    print("\nSample Prediction Result:", result)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
